Issue: Hybrid MSE columns disagree between documents
Where it appears: Main manuscript Table 4 gives CV MSE 0.6571, test 0.4602, unseen 0.9752; Hybrid model.docx Table 1 gives CV 0.4602, test 0.9752, unseen 0.1921
Recommended action: The columns are shifted by one between the two documents. Re-derive from the recomputed values in Table 2 and use a single set throughout.

Issue: Nu-SVR "Mean CV MSE" is actually the test MSE
Recommended action: In the source script 0.8591 is mean_squared_error on the 20% test set. Relabel, or replace with the recomputed CV MSE.

Issue: DNN narrative does not match its own table
Where it appears: Hybrid model.docx quotes DNN-1 R2 train 0.8044 / CV 0.7373 and DNN-2 0.9532 / 0.9323; Table 1 of the same document lists neither
Recommended action: Reconcile the text to the table, or supply the runs those numbers came from.

Issue: Duplicated rows in the DNN table
Where it appears: DNN-1 and DNN-3 are identical; DNN-2 and DNN-4 are identical
Recommended action: Two distinct architectures cannot give bit-identical metrics across seven columns. Re-run or merge the rows.

Issue: Base learners were fitted on different splits
Where it appears: Nu-SVR used random_state=1, all four DNNs used random_state=42, and the two were then stacked
Recommended action: The ensemble members saw different training sets. All results here use one split per run.

Issue: Hyperparameters were selected on the test set
Where it appears: W_new includes R2 test and the test MSE/RMSE/MAE, and the reported model is the W_new maximum over the n_components sweep
Recommended action: This makes the reported test R2 an optimistic estimate. Select on cross-validated R2 and quote the test set once, at the end.

Issue: Meta-learner trained on in-sample base predictions
Where it appears: No out-of-fold scheme is described for the Ridge stack
Recommended action: Stacking on in-sample predictions inflates the meta-learner. With out-of-fold stacking the hybrid no longer consistently beats Nu-SVR (Table 2).

Where it appears: 10 of 25 test rows and 4 of 13 holdout rows share a canonical SMILES with the training set at random_state=1
Recommended action: Report the structure-disjoint split alongside the random one (Table 2).

Issue: Model comparisons are not statistically resolvable
Where it appears: Hybrid test R2 0.6560 vs Nu-SVR 0.6532, a difference of 0.0028, on 23-25 test molecules
Recommended action: The bootstrap 95% CI on test R2 spans roughly +/-0.5. State that the models are statistically indistinguishable rather than ranking them.

Issue: SHAP interpretation attributes importance to protein confidence
Recommended action: The AlphaFold block is constant within a protein, so PC1 largely encodes target identity. Target dummies alone give CV R2 0.34. Reword the interpretation.
The matrix has exactly 272 feature columns. Fix the cell.

Where it appears: Methods describe four proteins; the data contain eight distinct pLDDT/PAE signatures
Recommended action: Groups 5-7 differ only in the third decimal and two are singletons. Verify which AlphaFold run each ligand was assigned.

Issue: Ligand-PCA columns are array dimensions, not deformations
Where it appears: Section 2.3 describes "PCA components shape" as structural deformations and "Average Structure Shape" as the mean conformation
Recommended action: The extraction script recorded pca.components_.shape and average_structure.shape. PCA-components-shape1 is the constant 3, Average-structure-shape is the ligand atom count (24 to 72) and PCA-components-shape2 is three times it. They correlate with pIC50 at r = 0.581. Describe them as ligand-size descriptors; replacement text in docs/METHODS_CORRECTION_LIGAND_PCA.md.

Issue: Impossible PAE mean for one protein
Where it appears: AlphaFold block, TDP1 (6N0D) signature: PAE Mean 30.07 with Q25 1.4, Q50 1.9, Q75 2.70 and Max 30.5
Recommended action: A mean cannot sit at the maximum when three quarters of the distribution is below 2.70. The source JSON gives 3.07, so a zero was inserted. The affected row carries the 17 most potent compounds. Correct to 3.07 in any revised matrix.

Issue: Hydrogen bonds and water bridges were never counted
Where it appears: ligand_protein_interaction_forces.py passed the same atom twice to the angle function, so both angles evaluated to NaN and every cutoff comparison failed
Recommended action: The 20 residue descriptors contain only hydrophobic and ionic contributions; cation-pi had a cutoff but no detection code. Methods should state which interaction types actually entered the features, or the descriptors should be regenerated with the corrected script.

Issue: AlphaFold pLDDT averaged over the wrong atoms
Where it appears: alphafold_feature_extraction.py zipped per-atom pLDDT against per-token residue ids, using only the first 248 of 1978 atom scores for 1SJ0
Recommended action: Roughly 87 per cent of each structure was discarded. Corrected values differ materially, for example 8AOJ rises from 69.30 to 87.29.

Issue: Repository does not contain the pipeline
Where it appears: The README advertises scripts/classical_ml_pipeline.py, hybrid_model_training.py, data/, models/ and outputs/; none exist in the repository
Recommended action: Publish the actual training code, or point the manuscript at this benchmark repository.
